sourceAudit.summary: Realtor.com, Redfin, Zillow, Homes.com, and Movoto were searched and cross-checked. New and known listings were deduplicated by address and MLS where corroborated. Movoto produced no additional credible current candidate.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Publicly indexed portal coverage is not exhaustive MLS coverage, and portal status, square footage, and MLS identifiers can conflict.

sourceAudit.summary: Indexed local brokerage, listing-agent syndication, and public builder inventory were searched. Compass, Trulia, local IDX pages, Homes.com builder inventory, and public new-construction pages were used to reconcile candidates and duplicates.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Some IDX pages require registration or expose less history than national portals.

sourceAudit.summary: HUD Home Store, Fannie Mae HomePath, and Freddie Mac HomeSteps were checked for Rock Hill and nearby York County inventory; no current candidate meeting the family criteria was identified.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Search indexing and inventory timing can lag; the result is not a representation of exhaustive REO availability.

sourceAudit.summary: Zillow FSBO, York County Master in Equity, and York County delinquent-tax sources were reviewed. Two active Rock Hill FSBO listings at or below the ceiling were added as diligence candidates. Current foreclosure rosters did not provide an inspectable, priced candidate, and the 2026 tax-sale list is not yet publicly indexed.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Auction, title, redemption, access, financing, and condition evidence remain mandatory before any distressed property could be recommended.

sourceAudit.summary: Auction.com, Hubzu, Xome, and public builder inventory were checked. A past Xome event and other indexed auction results did not meet the current-status, access, title, and layout evidence threshold. Current new-construction inventory was reconciled through public listings, builder pages, and city project reports.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Auction terms and title or inspection access were not adequate for candidate underwriting.

sourceAudit.summary: Canopy MLS Grid, Zillow Bridge, RentCast, BatchData, and ATTOM were not queried because the workflow uses only public sources and does not obtain third-party credentials or paid keys.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: The public discovery process cannot claim exhaustive MLS or paid-data coverage.

sourceAudit.summary: York County Assessor, One Map, Register of Deeds, and public-index routes were checked. Listing parcel identifiers and transfer histories were captured when public listing pages exposed them.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Direct parcel, current-owner, deed, lien, plat, and tax-district readback was not publicly retrievable for every candidate and remains a follow-up rather than verified evidence.

sourceAudit.summary: Rock Hill and York County permit, zoning, and rental-registration sources were checked. City project reports corroborated selected new construction, and an indexed permit trail was noted for 897 Eastwood. Public rules establish rental registration and an unrelated-occupant limit but do not establish authority for separate-room leases at each parcel.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Property-specific permit histories, legal bedroom counts, certificates of occupancy, zoning determinations, and written room-lease authority remain unresolved for recommendation purposes.

sourceAudit.summary: FEMA Flood Map Service Center and York County One Map paths were checked, with portal risk signals treated only as prompts for follow-up.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Property-specific FEMA or One Map flood determinations and insurance quotes were not reliably retrievable for every candidate and are not marked verified.

sourceAudit.summary: Public listing disclosures were reviewed for dues and association presence, but no controlling declaration, amendments, bylaws, rules, budgets, or written management confirmation were obtained.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Whole-unit and individual-room rental authority remains unknown for condominium or HOA-governed candidates, and special, transfer, capital-contribution, and mandatory fees remain unknown unless explicitly listed.

sourceAudit.summary: Zillow Rentals, Apartments.com, HotPads, and RentCafe were checked. Public listings ranged from roughly $850 to at least $1,614, while current published one-bedroom averages were about $1,309 to $1,398. The $1,150 planning benchmark remains conservative.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: These are public asking rents, not executed leases, and they exclude unadvertised concessions and some mandatory fees.

sourceAudit.summary: Roomies, Furnished Finder, and SpareRoom were checked. Conventional public room examples clustered around $800 to $850, including private-bath examples, while furnished shorter-term private-room asks extended from roughly $750 to $1,400. The configured $850 planning rent remains supportable but is viability-adjusted in underwriting.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Listings are asking rents, not executed leases; property-specific demand, utilities, furnishing, parking, bathroom access, and lease length must still be validated.
